描述_EN: as technology improves and the toy manufacturing process is developed, dolls are becoming more realistic. baby annabell, made by zapf creation, was named as one of the top toys of the year in 1999, 2000, 2001, 2005, and 2007, demonstrating her high level of popularity and ongoing success. this baby annabell doll from 2007 has the ability to turn her head, make various noises, drink from a bottle, and cry real tears.
描述_ZN: 随着技术的提高和玩具制造工艺的发展，娃娃变得更加逼真。 由扎普夫公司制造的安纳贝尔婴儿被评为1999年、2000年、2001年、2005年和2007年的年度最佳玩具之一，显示了她的高人气和持续成功。 这个2007年的安纳贝尔婴儿玩偶有能力转动她的头，发出各种声音，用瓶子喝水，并哭出真正的眼泪。
